verdict.rationale: Raygun documents SDK-level filtering that removes sensitive data such as credit card details before errors are sent (raygun-docs-12/24/47). On the server side, the only documented control is a narrow 'Disable IP address storage' application setting (raygun-docs-13), not configurable scrubbing rules. missing for 10: configurable server-side scrubbing rules for arbitrary fields/patterns, detail on SDK filter configuration (field names, patterns, per-language), independent or hands-on corroboration.
